items.title: American Airlines Subsidiary Envoy Compromised in Oracle Hacking Campaign
items.description: Envoy Air, a wholly owned subsidiary of American Airlines, has confirmed it fell victim to a hacking campaign exploiting vulnerabilities in Oracle’s E-Business Suite (EBS). The breach, first highlighted by the notorious Clop ransomware group, underscores the growing risks facing enterprise software in the aviation sector. items.title: New Phishing Attack Leverages Azure Blob Storage to Impersonate Microsoft
items.description: Threat actors are leveraging Microsoft Azure Blob Storage to craft highly convincing phishing sites that mimic legitimate Office 365 login portals, putting Microsoft 365 users at severe risk of credential theft.
